description: Asks which field validation rules (Null, 0, 2, '', '1', 'q', True, False, 1/0, CVErr(5)) are accepted when set, and whether an AddNew/Update with V = 5 is then accepted. Then rule [V] > 0 with V = 5, -1 and unassigned, with Required False and True. Then table rule [V] < [R] with (1,2), (2,1) and (1,Null), and table rule Null. EditMode and DBEngine.Errors are read after each Update, and the stored rows at the end. The fixture is a writable copy. Fixture r-expr-1-main2 is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.

args.text: CREATE TABLE Vr (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Vr PRIMARY KEY, V LONG, R LONG)
SELECT ID, V, R FROM Vr ORDER BY ID
